<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916694_theRebbe_636" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916694_theRebbe_636__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section is an addition to the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Addition*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that a person who sins is worse than the nations of the world in their essential nature, who inherently recognize G-d's will.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">What is written in the maamar "Basi LeGani" 5713, at the end of the paragraph,</t>
    <t s="1">that "the nations of the world and the klipos and the sitra achra do not transgress His will, blessed be He... </t>
    <t s="2">and a person who commits a transgression, who rebels against His will, blessed be He, is worse, etc." – its explanation is,</t>
    <t s="3">that one who commits a transgression is worse than the nations of the world as they are essentially, in their own right</t>
    <t s="4">(before they do anything),</t>
    <t s="5">and this means,</t>
    <t s="6">that by the nature of creation, there must always be within them the recognition of "the G-d of gods,"</t>
    <t s="7">so that they would then be unable to transgress His will, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="8">as Bilaam said, "I cannot transgress the word of the L-rd";</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section clarifies that nevertheless, by free choice, the nations can follow foolishness and violate the Seven Noachide Laws, as Bilaam did.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">But certainly, regarding the matter of free choice, the nations of the world can also follow the spirit of foolishness and transgress the Seven Noachide Laws,</t>
    <t s="1">as with Bilaam,</t>
    <t s="2">that due to the spirit of foolishness which covers and conceals,</t>
    <t s="3">there was within him the matter of "I have ventured"</t>
    <t s="4">(</t>
    <t s="5">Sanhedrin 102,</t>
    <t s="6">b)</t>
    <t s="7"> </t>
    <t s="8">b)</t>
    <t s="9">,</t>
    <t s="10">which is one of the Seven Noachide Laws.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
